limitations: Host hardware, workqueue, SRCU and regulator services are models; no kernel lockdep/KCSAN proof.
Full MCA remains disabled in production; GLINK ownership, notification/protection chain and SC96281 FOD integration unqualified.
OEM parking is synchronous instead of the official private thread; matching HAL timeout/shared CCI/rail close-reopen behavior requires hardware verification.
No added firmware binaries, no actual firmware programming, camera streaming or optical movement.
No production Rust/BTF/signature qualification, final DTB/DLKM/boot image or flashable package.
No physical charging, reverse charging, plug/replug, camera switching or standby acceptance.
